title: Achieving Collective Welfare in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Suggestion Sharing
reasoning: The paper explores methods to align self-interested agents with collective welfare in social dilemmas. It includes evaluations against 'moral learners' and a specific baseline called 'Intrinsic Moral Rewards' (IMR), which is grounded in the 'virtue-kindness moral type' from literature, thus containing a component of evaluating moral/ethical frameworks in agent behavior.
